analysis: Thyroid hormones play a crucial role in regulating various physiological processes. They are known to increase basal metabolism, enhance body heat production, promote growth, and support the development and maturation of the central nervous system. These functions are essential for normal bodily operations. However, thyroid hormones also exert a negative feedback mechanism on the pituitary gland, which results in the inhibition of Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) secretion. This feedback loop is a well-established principle in endocrinology, ensuring that thyroid hormone levels remain balanced. Given this understanding, the most likely correct answer is that thyroid hormones inhibit the secretion of TSH.
